entries.message: Let each engine event say what it does to its page
Let sidebar widget actions and update phases say what they do
Let agent messages and tool options say what they do
Let core kinds say what each of them does
Let each iCloud sync step take itself
Let each core change say who follows it
Let page and engine-edge objects carry what they do
Let settings pages, permissions and requests say what they do
Let setup steps, outcomes and lessons say what they show and do
Let studio steps, emblems and small choices carry their own behavior
Let sidebar drop targets and zones say what they take
Let sidebar lift previews size and place themselves
Let sidebar pointer and row actions say what they do
Let download actions, destinations and feedback say what they do
Let credential events, plans and sign-in answers say what they do
Let transient requests, lease dispositions and pulls say what they do
Let window sizes, sidebar toggles and Settings styles carry what they do
Let widget kinds, deck directions and gesture axes carry what they do
Let Peek's views and the card arrangement carry their own measures
Let window sizes, viewports and pagers carry the iPhone and iPad layout
Let the iPhone app's platform pieces hold their own rules
Let core queries and page values carry the rules that judge them
Let design tokens, Space colors, settings values and the Mac shell keep their own rules
Let credential records judge themselves
Let link preferences, routes and schemes judge themselves
Let sync records, addresses and reasons decide their conflicts
Let download, media and launch questions answer from their facts
Let pages, history, Spaces and brandings keep their own rules
Let import reviews, setups and session repair carry their own steps
Let each query say how it answers without an app
Refuse an address no Space holds as an unsupported address
Let a branding make the looks imported Spaces wear
Let sidebar rows, chrome, tabs, splits and Spaces carry their own rules
Ask each rule's owner directly instead of through old forwarders
Let the iCloud service and extension strip views keep their own measures
Let each navigation decision answer WebKit itself
Let engine commands, pending prompts and swipe decisions say what they do
Let the core's answers to the cloud transport note what they tell it
The welcome card on iPhone lines up with the rest of the welcome page.
Crest no longer quits when it can’t make an edit, such as one on a tab that just closed or a change only a Space’s owner may make.
Every place that shows Crest's questions now handles each kind of question explicitly.
A page reporting something Crest can’t use no longer closes the app.
Keep settings, studio and lesson panes as concrete views
Give each extension file one owner type
